title: Language of satisfiable encoded circuits
statement: Let an encoding of Boolean circuits assign binary strings to circuits and decode binary strings, with decoding after encoding recovering the original circuit and every successfully decoded string being the canonical encoding of its decoded circuit. The language consists of exactly those binary strings that decode to a circuit having a satisfying input; malformed strings are excluded.
hypotheses_covered: A binary encoding of encoded Boolean circuits is given
The encoding's decoder inverts its encoder
Every successfully decoded string is the canonical encoding of the decoded circuit
